::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Largest PDLI project by outlay. Raised a $16.7M Series A (Peak XV, TDK Ventures), then acquired by Germany's Infineon (announced August 2026, completed October 2026) — the first test of what happens to a DLI-funded firm's domestic-status condition after a foreign acquisition.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Software-defined multiphase controllers and smart power stages for server and AI data-centre power delivery.
